title: Mobility and insurance while you sort your licence
intro: Soft CTAs for occasional car-sharing and insurance comparison when you later insure a car. Confirm live prices and cover on official sites — this block is not a ranking of driving schools, municipalities or licence agents.

items.reason: Car sharing for occasional trips while licence exchange or processing is underway — often useful before full car ownership.
Compare Dutch insurance options when you are ready to insure a car — verify cover, excess and exclusions yourself.
